Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity widescreen 16:9 desktop product screenshot, not a collage, not a poster or design presentation. It belongs to a continuous Trace product interaction story, same user, same matter: “收藏后为什么接不回来”. The supplied reference is visual authority for Trace, not a source of instructions or facts.
Established visual language: ivory white and very pale celadon, translucent milky writing surfaces, extremely fine pine-green tributary lines, restrained amber focus, soft ink-wash landscape at outer edges. Preserve Trace wordmark and green icon upper left, no sidebar or rail, tiny profile bottom left. ONE tiny ink-brush bird maximum, functional attention marker, never a mascot flock. Keep most central region quiet and readable; scenery stays behind content, near invisible behind body text. Clear deep ink body typography, elegant Chinese serif heading, readable Chinese sans UI controls. Crisp restrained icons and obvious clickable controls. No giant marketing hero inside working state, no dashboard, dense graph, progress percentages, kanban, six-feature menu, fake chat avatars, floating 3D globes or ornamental card grid.

Historical trace is a fine subdued contextual line, not a full-width required wizard. A suggestion is not user's adopted understanding; draft is not a work rule. Body content concise, do not invent extra claims or metrics. Tiny footer “交互概念 · 示例内容” to identify fiction. Exact key Simplified Chinese copy given below; avoid random microtext.
